_doc: Anima VAE per-channel latent statistics (generated: cut out of the latents_mean / latents_std that
the decode_latents stage of tools/export-recipes/anima/pipeline_ref.py emits into
outputs/series/anima-pipeline/pipeline.safetensors — outputs/ is not tracked by git, so the values are copied here).
The source of truth is latents_mean / latents_std of AutoencoderKLQwenImage.config; the torch side is f32 too.
anima_latents_test.ts pins bit-identity with the hand-copied constants of src/anima/latents.ts.
